_comment: Criteria spec for the SYNTHETIC example data set orders_synthetic.csv (invented orders, see make_orders_synthetic.py). It shows the format; the criteria are an illustration, not a recommendation. Keys starting with '_' are comments.

problem.name: orders_synthetic
problem.title: Supplier evaluation from synthetic order records (example)
problem.role: You are a procurement professional with experience in supplier evaluation.

indicators.label: Mean unit price
indicators.rationale: Average price paid per unit over all orders (unit_price).

indicators.label: Defective unit rate
indicators.rationale: Defective units divided by ordered units over delivered orders (defective_units, quantity).

indicators.label: On-time delivery rate
indicators.rationale: Share of delivered orders with delivery_status 'On time'.

indicators.label: Mean lead time
indicators.rationale: Average days from order to delivery (lead_time_days; empty for cancelled orders).

indicators.label: Cancellation rate
indicators.rationale: Share of all orders with delivery_status 'Cancelled'.

indicators.label: Compliance pass rate
indicators.rationale: Share of orders whose compliance_check is 'Pass'.
